name: Chaos Art
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Art that paints itself, once, and never the same way again. Press start and a small society of independent painters goes to work: one school per piece, twenty-eight of them - Impressionism, Post-Impressionism, Pointillism, Expressionism, Fauvism, Cubism, Classicism, Bauhaus, Suprematism, De Stijl, Constructivism, Action painting, Color Field, Minimalism, Op Art, Orphism, Pop Art, Street Art, Art Nouveau, ink wash, Ukiyo-e, woodcut, mosaic, stained glass, Art Informel, biomorphic play, collage, Futurism - or, now and then, a deep three-dimensional space where ribbons of ink, coral and glowing threads grow. On the flat sheet the painters use the editor's own brush engine: oil, gouache, acrylic, charcoal, pastel, ink and real watercolor that bleeds and dries, with pigments that mix the way paint mixes. Every piece draws its own signature before the first mark - which words of the school it likes, how hard its edges are, whether it invites a guest painter from another school - so two pieces of one school never look like siblings. Give them a motif and they paint after it, never copying it: the picture on your canvas, a picture of your own or a text is read for its planes, its light, its edges and its depth and becomes the composition they work from, an abstract version of it in the school's own words. Nobody conducts them. Each painter is its own stubborn character with its own sense of the picture - what is empty, what is loud, where the weight sits - and none of them waits for another. The only thing they share is the artwork. There is no seed and no undo into the past: the same settings will never produce the same picture twice, because before you start, YOU charge the piece with entropy by moving your pointer over a field until the bar is full, and while it paints, your pointer keeps stirring the paint. When something beautiful happens, stop: a quiet strip of snapshots has been keeping the last minutes for you, so the moment you loved is never lost. Put the chosen moment on your canvas as a picture in your document's own proportions - and edit it on from there like anything else. A big order-to-chaos dial, energy, density and tempo set the temperament; palettes and Brand Kits set the colors, or the school picks its own. Everything is computed in your browser - no server, no upload, no account.
